what: THE SECOND SPEAKS: the lines the map's one voice says (UI [the ten changes: the UI's part], 10/24/26; rule 133; TUNING's changes 6 and 8, records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_QUICKER_AND_FUNNER_FOR_NORMIES_THE_TEN_CHANGES_10_23_26.md). Read at load by slices/bohemia_ui_materials.js (THE TEN CHANGES). WORDS overwrites any line here; a modder may too.
owner: WORDS (the words); UI (when they are said and the plate they are said on)
rules: Each teaching line is said once, the first time its thing happens, by his second (the first man of his company after him who is still with him).
Nothing is said in the first sixty seconds of play (the second votes); a line asked then waits, and goes stale after its ttl in seconds.
Nothing stops the march; a tap on the face lets it go. A line with no face is never shown (rule 19c).

Twelve words or fewer. The thing he needs to know is in English; a word of Spanish is flavour only and comes from the declared lexicon (engine/bohemia_people.js ES_LEX), never the required part (the language gate's hard rule).
The voice tells him what a thing is, never what to do (TUNING: hardcore kept).

phone_job.line: Oye. Posts on the phone are work. Touch one, it lights up.
phone_job.when: a job shows on the phone and he has taken none

party_sight.line: Crew on the road. One touch sizes them up, a second goes.
party_sight.when: a party within eight blocks and he has never looked at one

first_town.line: Town ahead. Inside: work on the board, and men for hire.
first_town.when: on the way to a town before he has been inside one

first_fight.owner: COMBAT ([the first fight teaches]: aim, cover, reload, said inside the fight)

first_pay.line: That's the work, mano: fight, get paid. Batteries feed us.

first_hurt.line: {name} heals in camp. A dead man doesn't. Cuidado.

first_hire.line: New blood eats too. {per} batteries a night, every man.

first_night.line: Every night the crew eats. No batteries, a man walks.
first_night.when: the first nightfall, after the tally

client_pay.who: the client who posted the job (the board's own person)

hurt.line: They got me. {days} days, then I'm back.
hurt.who: the man the fight laid up

dead.line: {name} didn't get up, carnal. He's gone.
